meta.title: Cosmo user guide – Tasks, habits, OKRs and calendar
meta.description: Learn how to use Cosmo: create tasks, track habits with a heatmap, plan your calendar with time-blocking and manage your OKRs. The complete guide.

chrome.heading: User guide
chrome.contact: Got a question? Reach us at

start.title: Getting started
start.subtitle: Create your account and get to know the app in 2 minutes.
start.step1Title: Create an account or try the demo
start.step1: Head to the home page. Click **Get started for free** to create an account with your email, or **Try the demo** to jump straight into a pre-filled version with no sign-up.
start.step2: From the sign-in window, click **Continue with Google** to authenticate in one click with your existing Google account.
start.step3: The left sidebar gives you access to every feature: Dashboard, Tasks, Calendar, Habits, OKRs, Statistics. The menu collapses automatically to leave more room for your content.
start.tip: **Demo mode** is ideal for exploring every feature with realistic data before creating your real account. Your demo data is not saved.
start.cardDashboardDesc: An overview of everything you're working on
start.cardNotificationsDesc: Alerts about your tasks and collaborations

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: Organise, prioritise and keep track of everything on your plate.
tasks.step1: Click the **+ New task** button at the top of the page. Fill in the name, due date, estimated duration and category. The task appears in the table straight away.
tasks.step2: Every task gets a priority from **1 (low)** to **5 (critical)**. Priority 5 tasks show in red, priority 4 in orange. Use this to focus on what really matters.
tasks.step3: Tick the circle to the left of the task. It gets struck through and archived. You can filter completed tasks with the **Done** button in the filter bar.
tasks.featBookmarkDesc: Star an important task — it gets a gold highlight and shows up in the Starred filter.
tasks.featDurationDesc: Set a duration for each task. The Dashboard then shows your total workload.
tasks.featFiltersDesc: Filter by Starred, Done, Overdue or Shared. Filters combine with each other.
tasks.featCollabDesc: Share a task with a friend via the share icon. They can see and complete it from their own account.
tasks.featCategoriesDesc: Attach each task to a coloured category (Work, Personal, Health...) to see where your time goes.

lists.title: Lists
lists.subtitle: Group your tasks by project or context for effortless organisation.
lists.step1: In the left sidebar of the Tasks page, click **+ New list**. Give it a name and a colour. The list shows up in the navigation panel instantly.
lists.step2: When creating or editing a task, pick the list it belongs to in the dedicated field. A task can belong to only one list.
lists.step3: Click a list in the side panel to show only the tasks it contains. The counter to the right of the name shows how many active tasks it holds.
lists.featViewDesc: Each list shows only its own tasks, with its own filters and sorting.
lists.featColorDesc: Give each list a distinctive colour so you can tell them apart at a glance.
lists.featAllDesc: The 'All tasks' view gathers every task across all lists.
lists.tip: Use lists to separate your projects: a **Work** list, a **Personal** list, one per client or per active project. It keeps different contexts from blurring together in a single view.

agenda.title: Calendar
agenda.subtitle: Plan your events and take in your whole week at a glance.
agenda.step1: Click a time slot in the week view, or the **+ Event** button. Set the title, date, start and end time, and category.
agenda.step2Title: Move it by drag and drop
agenda.step2: Grab an existing event and drag it to another slot or another day right in the grid. Let go to confirm — it saves automatically.
agenda.step3: Toggle between **Day**, **Week** and **Month** with the buttons at the top right. The Week view strikes the best balance between detail and overview.
agenda.featDragDesc: Drag any event to reschedule it in seconds, without opening a form.
agenda.featRecurringDesc: Create a weekly or daily event once — it repeats on its own.
agenda.featColorsDesc: Each category has its own colour. Your calendar becomes a visual dashboard of your time.
agenda.featCompactDesc: Empty time slots shrink automatically to keep everything readable.
agenda.tip: Block time in your calendar for your important tasks (time blocking). It prevents overload and makes your days more predictable.
agenda.note: The calendar and your tasks are independent. A calendar event is not a task — use tasks for things to tick off, and the calendar for appointments and work blocks.

habits.title: Habits
habits.subtitle: Build routines that last and watch your progress day after day.
habits.step1: Click **+ New habit**. Give it a name, a colour, an estimated duration and a frequency (daily, weekly, specific days). The habit appears in the tracking board.
habits.step2: Each day, tick the habits you've done by clicking the matching cell in the board. The cell turns blue and your streak goes up.
habits.step3: The board shows the last 7 days by default. Switch to the **Month** or **All** view to spot longer-term trends.
habits.streakDesc: The orange counter shows how many days in a row you've done the habit. The streak resets to zero if you miss a day.
habits.rateDesc: Shown in your statistics, it measures the share of days you ticked the habit off over the selected period.
habits.tip: Start with **2 to 3 habits at most**. It's far easier to build on small regular wins than to burn out on a long list from day one.

okr.title: OKRs — Objectives & Key Results
okr.subtitle: Set ambitious objectives and measure your progress with concrete indicators.
okr.krDesc: A measurable indicator that proves the objective is met. E.g.
okr.step1: Click **+ New objective**. Set a title, a description, a category, a start date and an end date (usually a quarter).
okr.step2: Inside the objective, click **+ Key result**. Give it a title and a numeric target. You can add several per objective (3 is good practice).
okr.step3: Every time you make progress, update a key result's current value. The objective's overall progress is computed automatically. When a KR hits its target, it turns green.
okr.featHealthDesc: Cosmo compares your progress with the time elapsed. If you're moving faster than the clock, the indicator is green.
okr.featDaysLeftDesc: A badge shows how many days remain before the objective's end date.
okr.featCategoriesDesc: Sort your OKRs by category (Product, Personal, Team) to keep things organised.
okr.tip: A good key result is **binary or measurable**: either you can put a number on it (e.g. 10,000 users), or it's met or it isn't. Avoid vague wording like "Improve quality".

stats.title: Statistics
stats.subtitle: Analyse your productivity and spot where you can improve.
stats.step1: At the top of the page, choose the period to analyse: **7 days**, **30 days**, **90 days** or a custom range. Every chart updates automatically.
stats.step2: Each chart covers one dimension of your activity — tasks completed, habits kept, OKRs advanced, total time invested. Hover the bars to see the details.
stats.step3: Compare week after week. A steady decline in one area is a signal to adjust your objectives or your habits.
stats.legendTasksDesc: Number of tasks completed per period
stats.legendOkrDesc: Key results achieved during the period
stats.legendHabitsDesc: Average completion rate of your active habits
stats.note: Statistics are computed in real time from your own data. The more regularly you use Cosmo, the more the charts reflect how you actually work.

premium.title: Premium
premium.subtitle: Get Premium access for free in a few seconds.
premium.cardAdDesc: Watch a short ad from the Premium page to get a full day of Premium access straight away. Repeat as often as you like, with no payment.
premium.cardCollabDesc: Share tasks with your friends and work together in real time.
premium.cardSupportDesc: Priority help whenever something goes wrong.
premium.step1: In the sidebar, click the **Crown** icon (Premium). You'll find the details of the offer and the activation button there.
premium.step2: Click **Get 1 Premium day**, then watch the ad through to the end. Premium access switches on immediately for 24 hours. You can repeat this as many times as you want.
premium.step3: From the Premium page you can check your current status and the time left. Renew your access at any point by watching another ad.
